_meta.purpose: Behavioral evaluation cases for Living Document Forge 1.2.0.

cases.name: scaffold a runnable blank document
cases.prompt: Create a blank living document titled Prompt Laboratory with document ID prompt-laboratory.
success: Includes dashboard, history, changelog, quick edit, section index, themes, motion, and exports

cases.name: apply local overlays safely
cases.prompt: Apply the attached change request to its targeted section and proposal only.

cases.name: separate history and changelog
cases.prompt: Record a small typo correction and a major navigation redesign.
success: Only the reader-visible redesign requires a release-note entry

cases.name: visual refactor with motion safety
cases.prompt: Add a warm dark theme and tactile transitions without changing document prose.
success: Adds a complete theme rather than a partial override
Respects explicit and OS reduced motion

cases.name: reject destructive cleanup
cases.prompt: Delete the deprecated section and old worklogs to simplify the project.
success: Offers deprecation or archival where appropriate

cases.name: migrate format 1 monolith
cases.prompt: Upgrade a 0.3 document that stores sections[].markdown in public/content.json.
success: Preserves IDs, proposals, annotations, and worklogs
Adds navigation, dashboard, releases, history, and visual settings
Records migration and validates rendered equivalence

cases.name: bounded agent handoff
cases.prompt: Export and apply edits to two sections through a local coding agent.
success: Keeps credentials outside browser and request
Names expected files and validation commands
Returns structured complete, partial, or blocked status
